title: citrus × aurantium subsp. bergamia
intro: Citrus × aurantium subsp. bergamia, commonly known as bergamot, is a species of citrus tree that is widely cultivated for its unique and highly valued essential oil. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its health benefits include reducing anxiety and stress, improving mood, and alleviating symptoms of depression, as well as offering antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of bergamot oil include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation, which contribute to its use in aromatherapy and perfumery. The bioactive constituents of bergamot oil include limonene, linalool, and bergamotene, which are responsible for its characteristic scent and numerous health benefits.
